findings.issue: The permanent mutation checker compiled module-containing sources in the repository root, leaving six untracked .mod files, so git status was not clean after running it.
findings.resolution: Every parent and mutant compiles in its own temporary workspace; a git-status preservation guard and a unit test were added.

review_rounds.note: The correction touched only the mutation runner and its test; the coordinator re-ran it on both toolchains and confirmed an empty git status.

adjudications: C1011's list is admission text; every selected C1011 facet is an admission claim, not an exclusion claim.
The specification functions are pure, nonintrinsic, not internal, not statement functions and take no dummy procedure, satisfying 10.1.11 p4.
SIZE(vals,1) and LEN(word) inquire nonoptional, non-assumed-size dummies.
